### Summary

The source tree at the pin has no turbulence model: there is no `src/turbulence/` directory among the source
directories the library is built from (`src_files`, {{< code src/CMakeLists.txt >}}), no key under `forcing:` or
`dynamics:` names a closure ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp HydroOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}), and no test
refers to one. The only trace is three output-variable descriptions, `eps`, `tke` and `mut`, in the output name
table ({{< code src/output/output_utils.cpp >}}), which no module fills. snapy therefore has no turbulence closure: sub-grid transport is the constant isotropic
viscosity and conduction of @sec-ch07-viscosity, optionally shaped in $x_1$ (@sec-ch07-x1profile). The files are not
described further.

### Derivation

No active numerical scheme is derived for this unavailable module.

### Numerical method

No active solver path uses it at the pin, as the source inventory above records.

### Code

Nothing to map: no source file at the pin implements a closure.

### Tests

No test at the pin refers to a turbulence closure.

### Limits

This entry records an absence, not a usable closure; a deck that expects one gets the constant viscosity only.
